definitions.explanation: A position one occupies, especially a coveted post, rank, or title. Carries a sense of authority or prestige attached to the spot.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}の{座|ざ}に{就|つ}く。
examples.english: to take the position of company president

examples.japanese: {王者|おうじゃ}の{座|ざ}を{守|まも}り{抜|ぬ}いた。
examples.english: He successfully defended the champion's title.

examples.japanese: {首位|しゅい}の{座|ざ}をめぐって{激|はげ}しい{争|あらそ}いが{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: A fierce struggle continues over the top position.

notes:
Often abstract: not a physical chair but a position of rank or honor. The same kanji also serves as a suffix in {星座|せいざ} (constellation) and in theater names like {歌舞伎座|かぶきざ}, which are separate uses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {座|ざ}に{就|つ}く: to take up a position
- {座|ざ}を{奪|うば}う: to seize a position from someone
- {座|ざ}を{争|あらそ}う: to compete for a position
- {座|ざ}を{明|あ}け{渡|わた}す: to give up one's position
